items.title: StyleSmuggler: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE under active attack
items.summary: An unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability actively exploited in the wild, allowing attackers to inject malicious code into Magento's template system and deploy persistent backdoors. Adobe released an emergency hotfix on September 7, 2026.

items.title: Magento vendor Fishpig hacked, backdoors added
items.summary: Fishpig, a vendor of popular Magento-Wordpress integrations, was compromised, leading to the injection of malware into their software and control of their servers, posing a significant supply chain risk to Magento stores.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-138
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. Adobe recommends applying this update in addition to the hotfix for CVE-2026-75650.

items.title: CosmicSting attack & defense overview
items.summary: Described as the worst bug to hit Magento and Adobe Commerce stores in two years, CosmicSting is seeing active mass exploitation, with stores being compromised at a high rate. It allows for the injection of persistent backdoors.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-92
items.summary: This update addresses critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including a critical unauthenticated customer account takeover (CVE-2026-71362) that allows privilege escalation and has seen exploitation attempts in the wild.

items.title: Amasty patches dozens of Magento extensions, 2 critical
items.summary: Amasty issued a significant security release for numerous extensions, fixing two critical vulnerabilities that could lead to remote code execution on affected Magento stores.

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in the Amasty Order Attributes extension allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without authentication, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Critical vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento
items.summary: Sansec discovered an unauthenticated PHP object injection flaw in the popular Mirasvit Cache Warmer extension for Magento, which could be leveraged for remote code execution.}
